newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stock exchange deputy chief Herbert Hui resigns.
newsitem.headline: HK stock exchange deputy chief Herbert Hui resigns.

text.p: The Stock of Exchange of Hong Kong said on Friday that Herbert Hui had resigned as deputy chief executive of the exchange, effective from April 30.
"Hui has a number of opportunities available and he will be making a decision shortly," the exchange said in a statement.
Hui joined the exchange from April 1989 and has been a deputy chief executive since January 1996 and executive director and head of listing since July 1992, it said.
Both chief executive Paul Chow and chief executive designate Alec Tsui said Hui has performed excellently as deputy chief executive, executive director and head of listing.
The exchange said Hui would not be involved in any corpoarte finance transactions before he leaves the exchange.
